mission_rules_text: Secure both Row 5 objectives and clear original Rows 1–4 within ten daylight turns. One reattempt is permitted after first-attempt failure.

Counterattack PC A uses packages 1 (3/10), 9 (4/10), or 11 (3/10). Overlapping markers reveal and retain the highest letter (A, then B, then C).
